name: Shroudborn
notes: Echoes in the Void. Some believe the Shroudborn are a surviving precursor race operating from beyond known space-time. UNCONFIRMED: influence rests on visionary experiences and cryptic transmissions; no physical artifacts definitively linked to them — only theory and myth. The map lists Shroudborn status as an open UNCONFIRMED question (myth / misinfo / real non-linear actors). Also referenced as possible nomadic precursor remnants in faction taxonomy. Status unknown (not extinct — possibly extant/transcendent).

naming_exemption.reason: Name "Shroudborn" preserved verbatim from cited precursor-codex / map source.
naming_exemption.authority: Precursor / Dyson Sphere Salvage Pass — 2026-07-21 (recovered-source preservation)

certainty_basis: Retagged from UNCONFIRMED 2026-08-09. The EXISTENCE of the Shroudborn legend is established in-world content (precursor codex: "Some believe the Shroudborn are a surviving precursor race…"); the TRUTH of the claim is disputed by construction, resting on visionary experience and cryptic transmission. LEGEND_CONTESTED is the tag for in-universe rumor/myth/disputed account, so this is a precision fix, not a promotion to fact.

social_function.use: The Shroudborn story is routinely invoked to justify modern AI restrictions.
social_function.why_it_matters: The legend is not inert. Whatever its truth, it does political work in the present, which is a fact about the galaxy independent of whether the Shroudborn exist.
social_function.care: Recorded as the use made of the story, not as evidence for or against the Shroudborn. The LEGEND_CONTESTED tag is unchanged.

attested_phenomena.manifestations: Cryptic visions and transmissions; memetic artifacts; alleged self-evolving broadcasts.
attested_phenomena.standing: All reported rather than established — the record's UNCONFIRMED basis is unchanged. Extends the recorded "visionary experiences and cryptic transmissions" with the memetic and broadcast forms.

prose_ledger_triage.note: One claim is the source-side instruction that produced this record's own certainty tag: "the history packet reads like 'truth' rather than 'staging hypotheses' — consider marking uncertain items (e.g. Shroudborn) with (UNCONFIRMED) or (LEGEND/CONTESTED)". Canon adopted it; certainty_basis already documents the retag.
